title: BizApp Record Slot Extraction (envelope)
description: Runtime contract for LLM-assisted slot extraction on BizApp record actions. The concrete `fields.properties` (types, enums, extras) and per-field `required` are generated at request time by com.openvie.api.chat.service.BizAppSlotAgent from the INSTALLED APP's manifest (entity.fields) — no per-app knowledge exists in code, so every installed or future marketplace app is covered without code changes. All slots are optional at the grammar level: the agent must omit values it cannot find; required-slot enforcement stays deterministic in BizAppIntentRouter/BizAppPayloadValidator.

fields.description: Slot values keyed by manifest field name. Values are normalized after extraction: enums mapped via manifest optionLabels aliases, dates to ISO yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm, numbers to numeric.
